analysis: Both units are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 563-1030), documentation of prior releases (v0.10.0, v0.10.1). The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md (head adds ~800 lines, including a new v0.10.6 candidate section, replacing the v0.10.5 heading). Only the base text and a truncated patch excerpt were supplied. No executable code, config, or workflow is modified in the supplied evidence, so no control is added, weakened or removed here. I did not see the head-side added text beyond the first lines of the patch excerpt, so I cannot evaluate the claims in the new v0.10.6 section (two-Mac clusters, cluster_runtime registration block, cluster pair approvals derived from release metadata, RDMA over Thunderbolt). Those describe new attack surface (cluster pairing trust, coordinator derivation of approvals from provider-reported cluster_runtime facts, new Thunderbolt/RDMA transport between Macs) which is not covered by the current threat model definitions (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011). That is a threat-model gap for the underlying code PRs, not something I can ground to a specific changed line in this documentation diff. The base-side text reviewed touches T-041 (prefix cache, SSD tier, encrypted KV; GLM SSD store defaults on), TB-012/T-059 style busy reasons, Autopilot adoption/holds, and the desktop API (loopback authenticated control API). These are pre-existing, described in already-merged releases, and not changed by this PR. Remaining integration question: the next pass should inspect the head-side v0.10.6 section and the code PRs it references for cluster trust boundaries, key custody over the cluster link, and whether the threat model needs a new trust boundary entry.
